entries.title: A close look at the advanced techniques used in a Malaysian-focused APT campaign
entries.description: Our Elastic Security research team has focused on advanced techniques used in a Malaysian-focused APT campaign. Learn who’s behind it, how the attack works, observed MITRE attack® techniques, and indicators of compromise.

entries.title: Adversary tradecraft 101: Hunting for persistence using Elastic Security (Part 2)
entries.description: Learn how Elastic Endpoint Security and Elastic SIEM can be used to hunt for and detect malicious persistence techniques at scale.

entries.title: Hunting In Memory
entries.description: Threat Hunters are charged with the difficult task of sifting through vast sources of diverse data to pinpoint adversarial activity at any stage in the attack.

entries.title: Hunting For In-Memory .NET Attacks
entries.description: As a follow up to my DerbyCon presentation, this post will investigate an emerging trend of adversaries using .NET-based in-memory techniques to evade detection

entries.title: Playing defense against Gamaredon Group
entries.description: Learn about the recent campaign of a Russia-based threat group known as Gamaredon Group. This post will review these details and provide detection strategies.

entries.title: Going Coast to Coast - Climbing the Pyramid with the Deimos Implant
entries.description: The Deimos implant was first reported in 2020 and has been in active development; employing advanced analysis countermeasures to frustrate analysis. This post details the campaign TTPs through the malware indicators.

entries.title: FORMBOOK Adopts CAB-less Approach
entries.description: Campaign research and analysis of an observed FORMBOOK intrusion attempt.

entries.title: Detection and response for the actively exploited ProxyShell vulnerabilities
entries.description: In the last week, Elastic Security has observed the exploitation of Microsoft Exchange vulnerabilities associated with ProxyShell. Review the post to find newly released details about this activity.

entries.title: Testing your Okta visibility and detection with Dorothy and Elastic Security
entries.description: Dorothy is a tool for security teams to test their visibility and detection capabilities for their Okta environment. IAM solutions are frequently targeted by adversaries but poorly monitored. Learn how to get started with Dorothy in this post.

entries.title: Collecting and operationalizing threat data from the Mozi botnet
entries.description: The Mozi botnet is an ongoing malware campaign targeting unsecured and vulnerable networking devices. This post will showcase the analyst journey of collecting, analyzing, and operationalizing threat data from the Mozi botnet.

entries.title: Ransomware, interrupted: Sodinokibi and the supply chain
entries.description: Learn how Elastic Endpoint Security's behavior-based protections prevented a targeted ransomware attack on multiple endpoints.

entries.title: Okta and LAPSUS$: What you need to know
entries.description: The latest organization under the microscope of the LAPSUS$ group is Okta. Threat hunt for the recent breach targeting Okta users using these simple steps in Elastic

entries.title: Nimbuspwn: Leveraging vulnerabilities to exploit Linux via Privilege Escalation
entries.description: Microsoft 365 Defender team released a post detailing several identified vulnerabilities. These vulnerabilities allow adversarial groups to escalate privileges on Linux systems, allowing for deployment of payloads, ransomware, or other attacks.

entries.title: Adversary tradecraft 101: Hunting for persistence using Elastic Security (Part 1)
entries.description: Learn how Elastic Endpoint Security and Elastic SIEM can be used to hunt for and detect malicious persistence techniques at scale.

entries.title: Collecting Cobalt Strike Beacons with the Elastic Stack
entries.description: Part 1 - Processes and technology needed to extract Cobalt Strike implant beacons

entries.title: Practical security engineering: Stateful detection
entries.description: By formalizing stateful detection in your rules, as well as your engineering process, you increase your detection coverage over future and past matches. In this blog post, learn why stateful detection is an important concept to implement.

entries.title: Embracing offensive tooling: Building detections against Koadic using EQL
entries.description: Find new ways to build behavioral detections against post-exploitation frameworks such as Koadic using Event Query Language (EQL).
